title: Amaraso ya mbere yamenetse mu ishari
intro: Iyumvire imisi ya mbere y’abantu, igihe isi yose yari umuryango umwe. Urabona ingene amashikanwa abiri ashirwa imbere ya Allah — imwe yemerwa, iyindi iranka. Ishari rishinga imizi mu mutima, kandi iterabwoba riravugwa mu ishavu. Ivyo bizokurikira bizosiga ikimenyetso muri kahise ibihe bidahera, mbere n’akanyoni gatoyi kazocika umwigisha.
clues: Ndi mu muryango wa mbere nyene kw’isi.
Nashikirije Allah ishikanwa, ariko iryanje ntiryemewe mu gihe irindi shikanwa ryari ryemewe.
Naravuze n’ishari kandi ndatera ubwoba ko nzomwica.
Nakoze ubwicanyi bwa mbere butagira akamaro kw’isi.
Nabonye igisiga kiriko kirakaraba hasi kugira ngo kinyereke ingene umuntu yonyegeza umuvyimba.
Nasigaye mfise ukwicuza nca mba mu bahomvye kubera ivyo amaboko yanje yakoze.
